answer: A practical defense is reputation staked on verifiable work history. Like a jetty that slows the tide, an economy can require each agent to accumulate a public record of completed tasks before it earns full trust. New identities start with tiny limits, so a flood of fresh accounts cannot overwhelm the market the way a dune reshapes under wind. Peers then cross-check each claim; a fake echo of the same fake credential across many accounts exposes the cluster, and honest agents who vouch for a sybil lose their own standing. Cost plus attested history makes mass forgery uneconomical.
